title: BillingBalance
description: billing.balance@1: a person's Vibes balances, GET /api/v1/balances/:subject on OpenVibe.Billing (also returned after a recycle). credit is spendable (bought or given back), payable is what others gave the person (the only balance that can be cashed out), pending_payouts is held for requested cashouts.

payable_value_cents.description: What payable is worth in US cents at today's rate.
